# Sourdough Schedule

## Evening starter refresh

- 30 g starter
- 60 g water
- 60 g flour

## Next-day dough plan

- autolyse for 45 minutes
- add salt after the first rest
- perform four stretch-and-fold rounds every 30 minutes
- cold-proof overnight in the fridge

## Failure signs

- dough spreading flat after shaping
- weak surface tension
- overproofed loaf with pale crust and little oven spring
